name: MONSTER CAR 2
description: Simulation model for the supplied nitro 4WD monster truck. Chassis geometry, mass inventory, and suspension values come from the supplied authored estimate; engine, clutch, fuel, tire, and brake dynamics remain clearly labeled estimates because no physical measurements or engine datasheet were supplied.

geometry_source.rights_status: User-supplied geometry and scripts are included in the repository with their original source hashes recorded.

sprung_mass_kg.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; mass inventory and inertia are estimated from the supplied Blender geometry/material assumptions. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

unsprung_mass_kg.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; average of the four geometry-derived unsprung corner masses; front/rear differences are collapsed to the solver's symmetric per-wheel value. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

sprung_inertia_kg_m2.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; suspended inertia tensor transformed into FRD using S = diag(1,-1,-1), flattened as [Jxx,Jyy,Jzz,Jxy,Jxz,Jyz] about the estimated sprung CG. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

wheel_spin_inertia_kg_m2.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; per-wheel tire and rim inventory mass with a 0.65 annular-mass factor; no wheel spin test was supplied. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

corner_x_datum_frd_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; source wheel-center X coordinates ordered FL, FR, RL, RR. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

corner_y_datum_frd_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; source wheel-center Y coordinates converted from left-positive to FRD right-positive and ordered FL, FR, RL, RR. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

corner_z_datum_frd_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; source wheel-center Z coordinates transformed to down-positive from a chassis datum at the 0.087 m rest axle height. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

cg_forward_from_datum_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; suspended CG X coordinate translated to the chosen rest-axle datum. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

cg_right_from_datum_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; suspended CG Y coordinate sign-converted to FRD right-positive. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

cg_height_above_chassis_datum_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; suspended CG height minus the chosen 0.087 m rest-axle datum. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

arm_inner_offset_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; absolute lateral coordinate of the front lower-arm inboard pivot L0. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

arm_length_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; lateral distance from the lower-arm pivot L0 to the wheel center W. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

wheel_center_rest_below_chassis_datum_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; mean rest wheel-center height converted to the selected chassis datum. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

tire_radius_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; supplied rest tire radius. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

suspension_stiffness_n_per_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; wheel spring rates and shock damping values are model-derived recommendations. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement. Averaged front/rear wheel rates.

suspension_preload_n.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; constant per-corner preload set to one quarter of the estimated 4.952 kg sprung mass times standard nominal gravity, supporting the supplied ride datum; it remains constant when laboratory gravity or spring scale changes, so zero gravity lets the suspension extend toward its droop stop. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

suspension_damping_n_s_per_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; average front/rear shock compression/rebound damping multiplied by the square of each supplied 0.273 motion ratio; compression and rebound asymmetry is collapsed to one effective wheel coefficient. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

tire_stiffness_n_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no tire vertical-load, pressure, or deflection test was supplied.

tire_damping_n_s_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no tire damping measurement was supplied.

tire_slip_relaxation_s.source: Simulation estimate; no tire slip-relaxation test was supplied.

travel_droop_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; absolute wheel droop travel. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

travel_bump_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; wheel compression travel. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

bump_stop_stiffness_n_per_m.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; simulation linearization informed by the model's 80.8 N maximum elastomer force at 2.36 mm crush; actual progressive bumper curve is not represented. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

bump_stop_damping_n_s_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no bump-stop damping test was supplied.

droop_stop_stiffness_n_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no droop-stop force or stiffness measurement was supplied.

droop_stop_damping_n_s_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no droop-stop damping test was supplied.

drive_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Derived placeholder from the estimated engine peak torque, source model gear ratio, and estimated gear efficiency; NitroDynamics replaces it each tick with clutch output torque.

brake_torque_per_wheel_nm.source: Simulation estimate for four-wheel mechanical braking; the supplied source contains no brake torque or stopping test.

brake_front_fraction.source: Simulation estimate; no brake split or differential brake measurements were supplied.

reverse_torque_fraction.source: The supplied transmission describes a single first gear and no reverse; NitroDynamics disables reverse drive.

drive_torque_fade_rad_s.source: Neutralized in NitroDynamics; the estimated combustion curve and centrifugal clutch, not the shared electric torque fade, define propulsion.

rolling_resistance_coefficient.source: Simulation estimate; no measured rolling-resistance test was supplied.

tire_friction_scale.source: Simulation estimate; no tire compound or surface friction test was supplied.

max_steer_angle_rad.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; mean of maximum inside/outside source steering-table angles because the shared solver uses parallel front steering. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

steer_servo_natural_frequency_rad_s.source: Simulation estimate; no steering-servo response measurement was supplied.

steer_servo_damping_ratio.source: Simulation estimate; no steering-servo response measurement was supplied.

hull_probe_centers_datum_frd_m.source: Derived nine hull probe centers from supplied collision GLB `assets/source-deliveries/monster-car-2/monster_truck_colisiones_1.glb` SHA-256 daf1fcc7caedb5115578f6e336af1f6b688921bc530ebdb9e2367bedcda968b5; chassis probes follow the lowest vertex of named source meshes, plus one roof and two lateral shell points; each uses an estimated 20 mm contact sphere.

hull_probe_radii_m.source: Derived nine hull probe centers from supplied collision GLB `assets/source-deliveries/monster-car-2/monster_truck_colisiones_1.glb` SHA-256 daf1fcc7caedb5115578f6e336af1f6b688921bc530ebdb9e2367bedcda968b5; chassis probes follow the lowest vertex of named source meshes, plus one roof and two lateral shell points; each uses an estimated 20 mm contact sphere.

hull_contact_stiffness_n_per_m.source: Simulation estimate for the shared point-sphere hull contact solver; no chassis contact test was supplied.

hull_contact_damping_n_s_per_m.source: Simulation estimate; no chassis contact damping test was supplied.

hull_contact_friction_scale.source: Simulation estimate; no chassis-contact friction test was supplied.

engine_displacement_cm3.source: Simulation estimate for a generic 4.6 cm^3 single-cylinder nitro engine and centrifugal clutch; the supplied source contains no engine manufacturer, measured RPM curve, clutch map, or fuel-consumption test.

initial_fuel_mass_kg.source: Simulation estimate of a 100 g starting fuel load. The source models a 118.1 g fuel-tank component but does not specify usable fuel volume, liquid mass, or whether that component includes its contents.

fuel_specific_consumption_kg_per_j.source: Simulation estimate for a generic 4.6 cm^3 single-cylinder nitro engine and centrifugal clutch; the supplied source contains no engine manufacturer, measured RPM curve, clutch map, or fuel-consumption test.

gear_ratio.source: Derived from supplied estimated geometry data SHA-256 510c3c822d4896174e26de930626b8abd6e3b232fd337c3348d7556fdc769ad0; product of the supplied 3.3077 differential and 2.6 first-gear ratios; the source labels these as adjustable model values, not product specifications. The source is a model-based estimate, not a physical measurement.

engine_curve_rpm.source: Simulation estimate for a generic 4.6 cm^3 nitro engine; no measured or manufacturer torque curve was supplied. Curve is a compact smooth approximation, not measured dynamometer data.
